scope.resolution: 512x512 unless customer requests a different fixed resolution
scope.seed_policy: Same deterministic seed sequence for baseline and kernel; record seed in validation.json
scope.comparison: Unmodified checkpoint versus CalibrixKernelScale with the exact same prompts and seeds

required_evidence: Queued workflow contains the custom node
Baseline and kernel PNGs for every prompt
SHA-256 image hashes and kernel checksum
Human reviewer sheet with prompt-level decisions

machine_quality.primary_metric: OfflineImageQuality or an agreed real image reward
machine_quality.interpretation: These are artifact-quality gates, not claims about sales or conversion lift.

human_quality.review_mode: blind paired comparison; reviewer sees baseline and kernel without labels
required_checks: no unacceptable anatomy or geometry defect for the product
no distracting crop, duplicate, text, logo, or watermark artifact
image is usable for the customer's stated catalog placement
human_quality.reviewers: At least one buyer-side reviewer plus one Calibrix reviewer; record disagreements.

business.production_rollout: Customer decides after testing its own real catalog and conversion metrics.
business.verified_badge: Only after technical, machine, and human gates pass and the artifact is reviewed.

acceptance_outcomes.accepted: Kernel passes all declared gates; deliver kernel license and validation bundle.
acceptance_outcomes.review: Kernel produces real artifacts but misses a gate; deliver report, do not issue a verified marketplace badge.
acceptance_outcomes.blocked: ComfyUI/checkpoint/node unavailable or artifacts incomplete; do not present a quality result.

failure_policy.quality_gate_failure: Customer receives the evidence report and one prompt-pack adjustment/retest at no additional service fee; no verified badge or production claim is issued.
failure_policy.customer_change_request: New checkpoint, new vertical, or new scoring target is a new pilot scope.
failure_policy.refund_boundary: Payment and refund terms are agreed before work begins; this package does not promise a commercial outcome.
